svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make ten from 50 x 50 x 5 angle: four 40 mm long (end beams) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: six 30 mm long (four for the purlins, two for the bearer).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each leg: one 9 mm hole on the middle of the length, 25 mm out

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the back of the other leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one leg flat on the face of one tube, the other leg flat on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the face of the tube it meets; one M8 bolt through each leg into

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a rivet nut in that tube. Drawn: rear right end beam corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both legs sit flat on their faces with the bolts in.
